formula: V_s = V_ref · N / 2ⁿ   (N valeur binaire codée sur n bits)
sketch:
Observe: R-2R ladder DAC schematic with N=4 bit switches at the
top; student flips each bit, sees the analogue output V_s step
through 2^N levels. Bar plot of V_s vs. binary input fills in as
they scan. Experiment: reconstruct a target sine wave by feeding a
pre-recorded bit stream — output "staircase" approximates the
sinusoid; student picks bit-depth N to bound the error. Evaluate:
given a target V_s, dial in the correct bit pattern. Wrinkle:
monotonicity glitch at bit transitions when resistors mismatch —
teaches DAC linearity.
